Basic Information

  • Full Programme Name: IAPS AI Policy Fellowship
  • Host Institution: Institute for AI Policy and Strategy (IAPS)
  • Location: Washington D.C. London or Remote
  • Mandatory Residential: 2 weeks in D.C. (February 22 - March 5 2027)
  • Study Level: Professional Fellowship (early to mid-career)
  • Duration: 3 months (22 February - 14 May 2027)
  • Funding Type: Fully Funded
  • Stipend: Senior Fellows: $24,000 - Fellows: $18,000 (+$3,000 for D.C./London track)
  • Application Deadline: 27 September 2026
  • Eligibility: Open worldwide

About the Fellowship

A fully funded three-month programme for professionals from varied backgrounds seeking to strengthen practical policy skills for securing a positive future in a world with powerful AI. Two tracks available: Research Track and Applied Track.

Tracks

  • Research Track: Produce a substantive piece of AI policy research with an IAPS researcher or external supervisor.
  • Applied Track: Hands-on policy work (workshops grant evaluation policy memos).

Day-to-Day Experience

  • Work independently on projects ranging from drafting briefings organizing convenings advancing research reviewing legislative drafts and working on technical guidelines
  • Weekly meetings with mentor (AI policy expert) and IAPS manager
  • Present project in final week
  • Begin with 2-week in-person event in D.C. (Feb 22 - Mar 5 2027)

Eligibility Requirements

  • Open to professionals from diverse backgrounds: policy technical academic government programs operations event organizing grantmaking
  • No prior technical AI experience required
  • Looking for people who want to develop careers in AI policy

Funding Details

  • Senior Fellows: $24,000 stipend (full-time 3 months)
  • Fellows: $18,000 stipend (full-time 3 months)
  • Additional for D.C./London track: $3,000 extra stipend
  • Travel & Accommodation: Provided for the 2-week D.C. residential event
  • Part-time options: Available for exceptional candidates

How to Apply

Submit application via the IAPS application portal. Application takes approximately 45 minutes in 5 sections.
